name: leo-starter-portfolio
title: Leo's starter: Portfolio
description: A studio-style personal portfolio: three.js hero, pinned story, a work strip that scrolls sideways, a reveal gallery and a page per project. All content in one file, no build step.
license: MIT (template code). three.js is MIT, fonts are OFL 1.1, Governor is MIT. See NOTICE.md.
author: Cardzo
stack: Web Animations API, CSS scroll-driven animations, View Transitions (no animation library)
features: 3D low-poly hero that reacts to pointer and scroll, lazy loaded, capped pixel ratio, paused off screen
Pinned 'how I work' story: the picture swaps as each chapter scrolls past
Selected work as a pinned strip that scrolls sideways (CSS scroll-driven, with a fallback), swipeable on phones
A page per project at #/work/<slug> with a View Transitions image hand-off
Gallery with clip-path reveals on scroll
Custom cursor on fine pointers only, never with reduced motion
Experience timeline that fills as you read, mailto link and copy-email button
Light and dark themes, reduced motion respected, no layout shift
Self-hosted fonts, no trackers, no external requests
Governor pre-installed: AI coding guardrails for Claude Code (tier 3)

demo.quick: Double-click index.html (3D hero shows its static fallback from disk)
